newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Zalm says EMU criteria come before timetable.
newsitem.headline: Zalm says EMU criteria come before timetable.

text.p: Dutch Finance Minister Gerrit Zalm said on Monday that he agreed with German Finance Minister Theo Waigel that Europe needed to put respect for the Maastricht Treaty criteria before the timetable for the single currency project.

"My government has always been in favour of a strict interpretation of the criteria," he told Reuters Financial Television. "I agree with my colleague Theo Waigel saying we need to put the criteria first."
He had been asked wnat he thought about calls in Germany for a delay in economic and monetary union if Maastricht Treaty criteria are not strictly fulfilled.
"I hope we do not need a delay, but you cannot start when everybody does not respect the criteria," he said.
